post.description:
RETIRED as a grant (founder, 2026-09-17: "remove the cohort grant
access. they would have to subscribe to get access or try for free for
14 days after"). The Registration app still calls this on every paid
cohort transition (Seam III), so it keeps answering 201 and still
creates or links the account — but grants NOTHING. The account is owed
the ordinary 14-day trial, started the first time the person signs in
(`auth.start_trial_if_owed`), and must subscribe after it. The 327
grants that existed were ended by scripts/retire_cohort_grants.py.

End a grant now (a refunded or cancelled registration). Leaves any
subscription or trial untouched — only the grant is withdrawn.

get.description:
The Study account a Registration participant is linked to. 404 when none —
the LMS answers that participant's enrolments as empty, never guesses.

post.description:
Find-or-create the Study account for a person arriving from the
Registration app (the LMS enrolment grant): participant link first, then
email; a new account gets a random password and no trial (the same rule
the question-bank grant applies). Commits — the LMS's own row is written
after, and both sides are idempotent.

The account a tutor teaches from (Doc 26 R2): the LMS asks for it when
a cohort names its tutor. Found by email or created with role `tutor`
(a student is promoted, an admin left alone); a NEW account is invited
— "choose your password or PIN" — through Communications. Idempotent:
the second call finds the account and invites nobody. Commits.
